title: Get your Replit project onto your Mac
goal: Download the project as a zip so {product} can open it

steps.find: your project in the Replit workspace

steps.say: Press the three dot menu at the top of the file list (the Files panel).
steps.find: the three dot menu at the top of the file list

steps.say: Choose Download as zip. Big projects can take a moment.
steps.find: Download as zip in the menu

instead.say: If the download fails, open the Shell, type zip -r project.zip . and press Return, then download project.zip from the file list.

steps.say: Open your Downloads folder and double click the zip to unpack it.
steps.find: the downloaded zip file in Downloads

steps.say: Drag the unpacked folder to somewhere you will find it again, like Documents.
In {product}, press Change folder and choose that folder.
steps.find: the Change folder button in {product_s} card
